<div id="readme" class="md" data-path="README.md"><article class="markdown-body entry-content container-lg" itemprop="text"><div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 class="heading-element" dir="auto">QuadratureOnImplicitRegions</h1><a id="user-content-quadratureonimplicitregions" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: QuadratureOnImplicitRegions" href="#quadratureonimplicitregions"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/hmegh/QuadratureOnImplicitRegions.jl/actions/workflows/CI.yml?query=branch%3Amain"><img src="https://github.com/hmegh/QuadratureOnImplicitRegions.jl/actions/workflows/CI.yml/badge.svg?branch=main" alt="Build Status" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">This package implements a quadrature method on implicitly defined regions following the algorithm in:</p>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/140966290" rel="nofollow">R. I. Saye, High-Order Quadrature Methods for Implicitly Defined Surfaces and Volumes in Hyperrectangles, SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing, 37(2), A993-A1019 (2015).</a>.</p>
<hr>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Simple exmaples:</h1><a id="user-content-simple-exmaples" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Simple exmaples:" href="#simple-exmaples"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Let <math-renderer class="js-inline-math" style="display: inline-block" data-static-url="https://github.githubassets.com/static" data-run-id="d1435e23f002b0d8dc5b9703d2add830">$\Omega=[0,1]^2$</math-renderer> and let <math-renderer class="js-inline-math" style="display: inline-block" data-static-url="https://github.githubassets.com/static" data-run-id="d1435e23f002b0d8dc5b9703d2add830">$\psi(x,y)=x^2+y^2-1$</math-renderer>. Our goal is to create quadrature nodes and weights on the subdomains:</p>
<p dir="auto"><math-renderer class="js-display-math" style="display: block" data-static-url="https://github.githubassets.com/static" data-run-id="d1435e23f002b0d8dc5b9703d2add830">$$\Omega_1=\left\{(x,y)\in \Omega : \psi(x,y)&lt;0\right\},\qquad
\Omega_2=\left\{(x,y)\in \Omega : \psi(x,y)&gt;0\right\}.$$</math-renderer></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using QuadratureOnImplicitRegions

ψ(x)= x'*x-1.0 
a,b=zeros(2), ones(2) #the unit interval. 
quad_order=10

#the nodes and weights on Ω₁
xy1,w1=algoim_nodes_weights(ψ,-1.0, a,b,quad_order)
#the nodes and weights on Ω₂
xy2,w2=algoim_nodes_weights(ψ,+1.0, a,b,quad_order)"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> QuadratureOnImplicitRegions

<span class="pl-en">ψ</span>(x)<span class="pl-k">=</span> x<span class="pl-k">'</span><span class="pl-k">*</span>x<span class="pl-k">-</span><span class="pl-c1">1.0</span> 
a,b<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">zeros</span>(<span class="pl-c1">2</span>), <span class="pl-c1">ones</span>(<span class="pl-c1">2</span>) <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span>the unit interval. </span>
quad_order<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">10</span>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span>the nodes and weights on Ω₁</span>
xy1,w1<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">algoim_nodes_weights</span>(ψ,<span class="pl-k">-</span><span class="pl-c1">1.0</span>, a,b,quad_order)
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span>the nodes and weights on Ω₂</span>
xy2,w2<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">algoim_nodes_weights</span>(ψ,<span class="pl-k">+</span><span class="pl-c1">1.0</span>, a,b,quad_order)</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">To plot the nodes, please see <a href="https://github.com/Hmegh/QuadratureOnImplicitRegions.jl/blob/main/tutorial/circle_and_sphere.jl">this tutorial</a>.</p>
<p align="center" dir="auto">
  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/8241188/293792129-8926d082-3b1c-48cb-a888-3882b1288f7f.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..m7jODob2jC0g8Cyd5zhETaLIZv_tskESPFrOAU-qfvg"><img src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/8241188/293792129-8926d082-3b1c-48cb-a888-3882b1288f7f.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..m7jODob2jC0g8Cyd5zhETaLIZv_tskESPFrOAU-qfvg" width="250" height="auto/" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
</p>
<p dir="auto">The same syntax can be used for higher dimensional regions. For example, in the case of the intersection of the unit sphere and unit cube, we only need to adjust <code>a</code> and <code>b</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="using QuadratureOnImplicitRegions

ψ(x)= x'*x-1.0 
a,b=zeros(3), ones(3) #the unit cube. 
quad_order=5 

xyz1,w1=algoim_nodes_weights(ψ,-1.0, a,b,quad_order)"><pre><span class="pl-k">using</span> QuadratureOnImplicitRegions

<span class="pl-en">ψ</span>(x)<span class="pl-k">=</span> x<span class="pl-k">'</span><span class="pl-k">*</span>x<span class="pl-k">-</span><span class="pl-c1">1.0</span> 
a,b<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">zeros</span>(<span class="pl-c1">3</span>), <span class="pl-c1">ones</span>(<span class="pl-c1">3</span>) <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span>the unit cube. </span>
quad_order<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">5</span> 

xyz1,w1<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-c1">algoim_nodes_weights</span>(ψ,<span class="pl-k">-</span><span class="pl-c1">1.0</span>, a,b,quad_order)</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For the outer region, we only need to change <code>-1.0</code> to <code>1.0</code></p>
<p align="center" dir="auto">
  <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/8241188/293801890-43354dab-7818-46eb-8ee2-c65b394b0369.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..5oiYKjo6eY4fj8RU1zOREy6VSnJAEl0tTTmhc5obGpE"><img src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/8241188/293801890-43354dab-7818-46eb-8ee2-c65b394b0369.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..5oiYKjo6eY4fj8RU1zOREy6VSnJAEl0tTTmhc5obGpE" width="250" height="auto/" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
</p>
</article></div>
